title: Normalized coefficient comparisons and canonical localized Gamma representatives
statement: Use the finite-field and four-stage six-functor datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], exceptional admissibility of [def-weil-exceptional-adjoint-admissibility], and the supplied full-domain five-arrow chain $\Gamma$ of [def-sf-tensor-hom-chain-data]. The coefficient stage selectors are [def-sf-ctf-coefficient-stage-selectors], and the forward projection and fixed-left Hom are [def-pod-ctf-pairing-maps]. Define a normalized coefficient-comparison datum on two such full domains to consist of the specified ordinary and exceptional adjunction comparisons of [def-exchange-projection], tensor comparison isomorphisms and their counit-normalized internal-Hom evaluation transposes, the tensor comparison normalization for the compact-support first input, and compatibility with the actual forward projection. The Hom transposes are morphisms, not assumed invertible. Define the endpoint maps $\alpha_A$ by ordinary direct-image comparison, X-Hom transpose, and exceptional-input comparison, and $\alpha_B$ by the normalized target Hom transpose. Define its coefficient square to be $T(\Gamma z);\alpha_B=\Gamma\prime(Tz;\alpha_A)$ for every test arrow. The permitted coefficient maps are finite quotient reduction, integral reduction, and completed integral scalar extension. For an integral chain with endpoints $A,B$, let $b=\Gamma_A(1_A):A\to B$ and $a=\Gamma_B^{-1}(1_B):B\to A$. Their inverse identities define the canonical representing isomorphism $A\simeq B$. Transport the integral chain to ambient Hom groups by full inclusion. Define its rational representative by applying the raw localization functor of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] to this isomorphism, and its rational Hom equivalence by postcomposition with that representative. At a finite coefficient field $F$ in [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], define common source and target by including the rationalized endpoints at $F$, their common representative by including the rational representing isomorphism, and the common Hom equivalence by postcomposition. At a common overfield $G$, define the stagewise Gamma by postcomposition with the recorded scalar transition of the rational representative. All maps are specified by these formulas, with no arbitrary compatible family or choice of representing map. Define the field coefficient-square predicate to consist of the rational equation $T\Gamma(u);\alpha_B=\Gamma\prime(Tu;\alpha_A)$ for every fractional arrow and the same equation for every common-stage arrow, using the canonical scalar-transition inclusion isomorphism for its endpoints. Define the signed-shift transport predicate, for structural arrows $a,b$, integer shift $r$ and integer sign $k$, to say that the given integral equation $\gamma\prime;b=a;k\gamma[r]$ has the corresponding rational and common-stage equations under localization and inclusion. These last predicates define the requested equations, without asserting them.
